reasoning: This is an abstract UI chrome glyph (down-and-right corner arrow) typically used to indicate nested sub-items, indentation, or forwarding/redirection. Because it shows no concrete object and is easily confused with other directional arrows or return/reply icons, it fails as a glanceable subject reminder for to-do tasks.
